correctness.rationale: Exact x-sum gives S'=S(1-S); exact frequency reduction and strict entropy yield global p→(1/3,1/3,1/3). On the zero-sum plane the linear drift is -3mu I+a S B with B skew and B²=-I/3; the remainder is quadratic. Since p→e, log-amplitude correction is integrable, hence exp(3mu t)||p-e|| tends to a strictly positive number for all nonuniform initial frequencies. Removing the exact rotation produces a convergent nonzero vector with O(e^-3mu t) interaction-picture error. Orthogonal splitting and logistic asymptotics establish three positive limiting norm constants. 60 exact-rational test cases and two phase-corrected numerical trajectories reproduced with embedded check.py; finite evidence is only diagnostic.
